## Project Overview

This project explores the breakdown of police spending and social spending in each of Washington state's 39 counties. Using Washington state fiscal information, I am looking at each county’s budget to see which counties spend the most on social services relative to their police spending. Further, I am looking at crime statistics by county to explore the relationship between police spending, social spending, and crime. Because some studies have shown that police spending reduces crime short-term while social spending reduces crime long-term, I am going to identify any significant changes in a county’s police or social spending, then evaluate the impact of these changes on crime after a given period.
